title: Independent interface density
action: Add Compact, Comfortable and Large-control presets separately from text scale; preview a build row, alert and inspector.
criterion: Each preset passes 1280×720 at 100%,150%,200% text and keeps every primary action reachable by scroll/focus.

title: Resizable and collapsible sidebar
action: Allow a persisted sidebar width and collapse to a tab rail; give inspection a reopen shortcut.
criterion: Resize/collapse retains tab, selection and scroll position; clicking revealed map area places correctly.

title: Named actions and remapping
action: Move direct key checks into named actions; add binding capture, conflict display and restore-defaults.
criterion: A player completes cancel, pause, pan, zoom, toggle, undo and overclock with every default binding changed; help shows actual bindings.

title: Complete keyboard construction
action: Add a visible tile cursor, keyboard tool choice, candidate cycling, confirm and cancel.
criterion: A new run reaches first Cycles delivery and first Cash using only keyboard; keyboard placement shares the mouse validator.

title: Controller navigation contract
action: Specify controller focus order and map interaction states; show contextual confirm/cancel labels.
criterion: One controller builds, connects, inspects, opens Settings and exits without a mouse; UI navigation never pans the map.

title: Camera preferences
action: Expose pan speed, edge-pan on/off and delay, invert wheel, and drag sensitivity; persist per user.
criterion: Edge-pan off yields no camera motion at any screen edge; speed settings cover slow inspection and full-map travel.

title: Zoom around the task
action: Anchor zoom to pointer or keyboard placement cursor; offer selected-object anchoring.
criterion: Across 0.4–3× zoom, the chosen world point stays within two screen pixels of its prior position.

title: Comfortable interaction targets
action: Increase tabs, alert buttons and output steppers with spacing; allow target size independent of font size.
criterion: At Comfortable density, primary targets have at least 44×44 logical pixels and remain distinct at 720p.

title: Separate visual motion channels
action: Offer separate city ambient, packet trail, alert pulse and automatic-camera options with a global Reduce-all toggle.
criterion: Reduce-all freezes decorative animation in menu and world while flow direction and warning state remain visible.

title: District identity without hue memory
action: Overlay optional district patterns and resource glyphs on placement areas and minimap; retain text names.
criterion: In a grayscale view, a player can locate legal Cycles, Intel and Crypto ground and identify a blocked placement.

title: Meaningful accessibility metadata
action: Give icon-led tools and controls explicit names, descriptions, values, state and focus order; selective event announcements.
criterion: Inspect the engine accessibility tree: no primary action has an empty name; research, output and modal state changes are understandable.

title: Expandable resource dashboard
action: Group reserves, operating conditions and goal; provide wrapped compact rows and an optional expanded view.
criterion: Stocks from0 to1,000,000 and all warning combinations remain readable at1280×720; expanded view adds the hidden rates.

title: Explain each reserve
action: Give every resource a tooltip/focus help showing production source, consumers and one recovery action.
criterion: All six resources answer where it comes from, what spends it and how to obtain more; no internal identifiers appear.

title: Cause-first operational badges
action: Centralize status labels with cause and duration: disabled, unlinked, quarantine, blackout, underfed, congested.
criterion: Inspector, map badge and alert agree on the fixture state; quarantine says remaining seconds and retains the physical path description.

title: Progressive inspector detail
action: Lead with actual delivered output, upkeep and limiting condition; make homage and formulas expandable and pinnable.
criterion: A constrained node's first three lines explain why output is low; selecting another node does not reset a pinned comparison.

title: Message history and replay
action: Add an action/incident history with timestamps, severity and pinning, alongside a persistent action message channel.
criterion: A player can retrieve the last placement failure, contract expiry and save result after changing tools; ambient hints do not flood history.

title: Impact-ranked diagnostics
action: Rank alerts by threatened useful output, recovery difficulty and threat urgency; show estimated affected branch size.
criterion: A disconnected high-value branch ranks above an idle cheap node; ties are stable and priority criteria are shown in help.

title: Visit and repair all alert targets
action: Cycle all affected objects; show current target index, cause and suggested actions; include focus-only operation.
criterion: With three overloaded links, three activations visit each once, preserve correct inspection and expose one valid repair per target.

title: Focus help and discoverable locks
action: Make build descriptions available on focus; show required research and allow navigation to it for locked tools.
criterion: Mouse and keyboard show the same help; activating a locked entry reveals its complete prerequisite path without spending resources.

title: Teach a viable opening with checkpoints
action: Use short optional objectives for a legal Cycles source and working tunnel before Intel/Market; keep a resettable hint.
criterion: On ten representative seeds, a novice can identify first usable ground and obtain first Cycles delivery without exhausting the opening budget.

title: Research previews with purpose
action: Show the unlocked recipe/protocol, operating cost, intended use and prerequisite chain before purchase.
criterion: Every tech card answers what changes in play and offers a jump to the unlocked tool; preview matches the live recipe constants.

title: Exact recipe cards and measured rates
action: Show fractional nominal rates, input/fuel rates, and actual recent completion rates side by side.
criterion: Forge shows0.6 Tools/s,0.6 Intel/s,1.8 Cycles/s; Lab shows0.5 RP/s,0.5 Intel/s,1 Cycles/s before route losses.

title: Visible converter trip lifecycle
action: Show requested input, in-flight input, processing arrivals and returning output so the round trip is inspectable.
criterion: After enabling a distant Lab, its card explains the initial no-output interval and can highlight both input and return packets.

title: Travel time in familiar units
action: Display predicted arrival seconds and converter round-trip delay alongside distance; reflect current feed speed.
criterion: At full feed and25% feed, a deterministic route's arrival prediction differs from measured travel by at most one simulation tick.

title: Construction commitment preview
action: Show complete build cost, ICE surcharge, running Cycles cost and post-purchase reserve; distinguish provisional from final route.
criterion: The preview and actual debit match for every structure/protocol and ICE tier; unaffordable totals explain which reserve is short.

title: Capacity breakdown and comparisons
action: Expose protocol, node, fan-in and relay modifiers with offered/delivered traffic per direction; compare one upgrade.
criterion: For a five-child Proxy, the card reconstructs its effective cap from the same model and shows whether upgrading the protocol helps.

title: Loss breakdown with useful counterplay
action: Split distance, congestion, hot-Trace and disconnected/quarantine losses; estimate end-to-end yield.
criterion: A two-cell DNS at hot Trace shows3% distance and20% ICE separately, producing77.6% survival; advice targets each active cause.

title: Protocol comparison panel
action: Show upkeep, noise, loss per distance, effective capacity and break-even use case for all unlocked links.
criterion: A player compares DNS/VPN/TCP/HTTP/Onion for the selected route without placing a temporary link; figures match actual simulation.

title: A readable Continue capsule
action: Show save date, version, seed, objective progress and last activity on Continue; distinguish missing and unreadable saves.
criterion: A valid save previews without replacing the live run; a malformed save explains why Continue is unavailable and offers a safe new run.

title: Minimap geometry and layers
action: Preserve square-world proportions; draw the actually exposed map rectangle; allow district, vision, network and threat layers.
criterion: Landmark positions agree between minimap and world; sidebar-covered world is excluded from the exposed-view rectangle.

title: Camera recovery and bookmarks
action: Add Home-to-C2, fit-botnet, selectable node list and a small set of named camera bookmarks.
criterion: After panning beyond every edge, one action returns to a visible C2; bookmarks persist with the save and honor zoom.

title: Display controls inside the game
action: Add window/fullscreen, resolution and UI safe-area controls with timed revert for unreadable changes.
criterion: Changing display mode keeps essential controls on screen; failed/unconfirmed mode changes revert automatically with prior settings restored.

title: Settings before the first run
action: Expose accessibility Settings from the main menu with a live sample and initial keyboard focus.
criterion: A user enables large text/reduced motion before New Game; the menu, sample and next game reflect the choice immediately.

title: Localizable text and terminology
action: Move player text to translation keys and one glossary; replace mixed CPU/Cycles, RP/Research, Data/Intel, Credits/Cash wording.
criterion: A pseudolocalized text pass at30% expansion retains all actions; the default language uses one name for each resource throughout hints/help.

title: Contextual shortcut and interaction guide
action: Add a Help action showing current bindings, click/drag behavior, selection rules and a replayable construction demonstration.
criterion: Help is reachable from menu, pause and gameplay by keyboard; its bindings update after remapping and every depicted interaction works.
